name: Growth Aura
description: Crops and berries grow faster nearby

growthMultiplier.label: Growth Multiplier
growthMultiplier.tooltip:
Multiplier on crops ticked per pulse, on top of the proficiency-derived base count.
§7Crops ticked per 30s pulse (rounded down, min 1):
§8  Prof 1: 1 × multiplier
§8  Prof 2: 1 × multiplier
§8  Prof 3: 2 × multiplier
§8  Prof 4: 2 × multiplier
§8  Prof 5: 3 × multiplier
§7Search range also scales with proficiency (base radius × 1 to 5).
